backgrounds.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone wide website background illustration, NOT a screenshot or a mockup. Create the clean background artwork needed to implement the accepted CS2-themed YAR CYBER SEASON design in HTML. Reference image: accepted CS2 Matchday UI, use ONLY its river architecture, cold lighting and metal-blue palette as visual grounding. REMOVE all UI ideas: no lettering, no scoreboard, no buttons, no border, no panels, no logos, no watermarks.
A cinematic Yaroslavl-inspired Volga river embankment at blue hour, recognizably Russian white-stone church towers and onion domes on the opposite riverbank, quiet reflections in dark water, distant city silhouette, cold evening air. This is an artistic local-city scene, not a claim of exact photographic geography. Restrained graphite and deep navy fading to icy blue; a little silver-white light on architecture. Architecture is grouped across the center-right, with softly graded darker empty sky and water at left to accept HTML heading overlay. Horizon around 42 percent down. Detail rich but no noisy texture under text. No people or armed soldiers, no game logos, no crosshair, no chairs. The image should be attractive both as a wide 3:1 hero crop and a 16:9 broadcast thumbnail using object-fit; keep the central-right architecture safe in crops.
Target dimensions 2560×1440 landscape 16:9. Full-bleed image, naturally proportioned buildings. Preserve the adopted industrial-cool mood without copying any of the UI itself.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone wide background illustration for the accepted Dota 2 theme of the YAR CYBER SEASON website. Reference image is the accepted Dota Matchday UI; use ONLY its fantasy Russian river city scenery and rich autumn dusk mood. Create image artwork with NO user interface: no letters, numerals, logo, game marks, banners, border, frame, buttons, panels, score, characters or watermarks.
Yaroslavl-inspired riverfront at autumn dusk, Russian white-stone onion-domed churches and bell towers grouped along the center-right bank, soft mist over a deep forest-green river with long bronze sunset reflections. A restrained fantasy painting with believable architectural proportions, real masonry, evocative warm windows and distant amber sky. Framing foliage in top-right and at far edge only, NOT a rectangular decorative frame. Near-left water and sky remain quiet darker green and charcoal, providing negative space for live HTML copy. The scene feels crafted and painterly, ancient and alive; jade shadows with aged-bronze highlights. No neon magic, no floating islands or random monsters. Keep visual hierarchy strong and textures gentle under potential text.
Target landscape16:9,2560×1440. Horizon at~43percent. Keep principal skyline center-right safe for both 3:1 hero crop and16:9 thumbnail. This is artistic local-city scenery, not exact photographic geography. Do not include any of the UI visible in the reference. Full-bleed picture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone wide architectural background for a premium editorial sports website, YAR CYBER SEASON corporate theme. Reference is accepted corporate Matchday screenshot; derive ONLY the blue-duotone river architecture image and white/cobalt editorial mood, never copy any UI.
Create a sophisticated clean photograph-like artistic view of Yaroslavl-inspired Russian riverfront, white church architecture and onion domes across the opposite bank, calm wide river reflecting the buildings, a luminous pale sky. Monochromatic near-white and cobalt blue duotone, navy architectural shadows, airy editorial finish. Buildings concentrated center-right; sky at left opens into soft white negative space so dark HTML heading text can sit over the left third. Very subtle cobalt stipple or lithographic grain near building silhouettes, but fine clean readable background. This should feel like an architectural sports editorial image rather than a fantasy setting or a dark gaming screen. No autumn orange, no medieval torches, no soldiers, no people, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no play symbol, no watermark, no framing border.
Target dimensions2560×1440,16:9. Horizon45percent. All architecture naturally proportioned, full-bleed view with useful image content in both 3:1 wide hero and16:9 thumbnail crops. Artistic Yaroslavl-inspired scenery, not a claim of exact photographic geography. Pure image asset, never a UI mockup.

files.textures/cs2-metal.png:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production website material texture, opaque square, target 1024×1024 or higher at 1:1.
Primary request: one uninterrupted full-frame dark matte graphite / gunmetal surface for the accepted YCS CS2 theme. Attached screenshot is only a reference for cool material and palette, not composition.
Surface: very fine dark metal grain, subtle horizontal brushing, a few fine superficial worn scratches. Cool near-black blue-grey, restrained gunmetal, slight tonal variation. Texture should remain low-contrast everywhere so UI text remains readable over it.
Lighting: broad perfectly even diffuse light, no directional spotlight, no highlight stripe, no vignette. Orthographic material close-up with no perspective.
Composition: material fills all four edges, no object, no central focal point, no border. This will be used as a cover texture under HTML; it is not a mockup or panel.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no symbols, no shapes, no UI, no borders, no buttons, no plates, no frames, no seams, no cyan LEDs, no stripes. Do not copy screenshot layout. Show only tactile fine-grained matte dark metal.
files.textures/dota2-stone.png:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production website material texture, opaque square, target 1024×1024 or higher at 1:1.
Primary request: one uninterrupted full-frame dark green-black stone / slate surface for the accepted YCS Dota 2 theme. Attached screenshot is only a reference for the carved stone material's palette and age, not composition.
Surface: aged dense fine-grained forest-green-black slate, subtle natural mineral pores, shallow very delicate thin hairline cracks, restrained tactile weathering. Much quieter than raw rock, clean enough for warm ivory UI text over it. No large cracks, no holes, no raised facets, no stones arranged as a wall.
Lighting: broad perfectly even diffuse light, no glow, no spotlight, no dramatic vignette. Orthographic macro material, no perspective.
Composition: material fills all four edges, no border, no focal subject, no objects. A cover texture beneath HTML rather than a mockup or panel.
Color palette: mostly near-black evergreen and charcoal with muted green mineral variation; no bright emerald or gold.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no runes, no UI, no borders, no ornaments, no frames, no buttons, no stripes, no gemstones, no moss leaves, no metallic material. Do not copy screenshot layout. Only dark, subtle, real-feeling slate texture.
